newsitem.title: USA: Marvel confirmation hearing slated April 24.
newsitem.headline: Marvel confirmation hearing slated April 24.

text.p: The U.S. Bankruptcy Court has set a date of April 24 for the confirmation hearing of Marvel Entertainment Group Inc's reorganization plan, according to a court spokeswoman.

The confirmation hearing was pushed back from the initial date of March 7 after Judge Helen Balick last week ruled to lift an automatic stay that would permit bondholders to vote and foreclose on stock that collateralizes their bonds.
A disclosure hearing, however, will occur on March 7, the spokeswoman added.
Bondholders have been fighting a Marvel Chapter 11 reorganization plan of majority investor Ronald Perelman that would essentially reimburse them 4-1/2 cents on the dollar in return for the stock.
